name: SSDNeRF
definition: A method that learns generalizable 3D priors through a single-stage 3D latent diffusion model, jointly optimizing NeRF and diffusion components end-to-end from multi-view images.
summary: SSDNeRF is a unified framework that jointly optimizes a NeRF auto-decoder and a latent diffusion model in a single stage to enable robust 3D reconstruction from sparse views.
